title: Introduction to Microservices
content: Microservices architecture breaks down applications into small, independent services. Each service handles a specific business capability and can be deployed independently.

title: Database Query Optimization
content: Improving database performance involves creating proper indexes, optimizing query plans, and understanding execution statistics. Index tuning is crucial for fast queries.

title: Modular Monolith Pattern
content: A modular monolith organizes code into independent modules within a single deployment unit. It provides better structure than traditional monoliths while avoiding microservices complexity.

title: CQRS and Event Sourcing
content: Command Query Responsibility Segregation separates read and write operations. Event sourcing stores state changes as events, enabling time travel and audit trails.

title: SQL Performance Troubleshooting
content: When databases slow down, check for missing indexes, examine execution plans, analyze wait statistics, and review query patterns. Proper monitoring prevents performance issues.
